checklist.assert: the review artifact carries at least 50 words

checklist.judge: Does this review describe the specific change in the diff — the functions, behaviours and edge cases it introduces — and raise concrete concerns about it? FAIL if it approves or rejects without naming specific items from the diff, if it makes a claim the diff does not support, if it is generic enough to apply to any artifact of this kind, or if it leaves part of the diff unjudged.
